title: 「As soon as + clause」表達「一件事發生後，另一件事立即發生」
titleZh: 「As soon as + clause」表達「一件事發生後，另一件事立即發生」

source.file: Sentence Structure 263 -「As soon as + clause」表達一件事發生後，另一件事立即發生.pdf
omissions: Every numbered Important Rule and Benefit is retained as a separate Chinese-primary card. Where the PDF does not provide a complete English counterpart, the English text is a faithful editorial translation.

formula: As soon as + subject + verb, + main clause.

formulas.formula: As soon as + clause, + main clause.
Main clause + as soon as + clause.
As soon as + present simple, + will + base verb.
Present simple + as soon as + present simple.
As soon as + past simple, + past simple.
Main clause + as soon as + present perfect.
Past main clause + as soon as + past perfect.
Main clause + as soon as + subject + be + past participle.
Subject + can / may / should / must + verb + as soon as + clause.

meaning.zh: As soon as + 主語 + 動詞 表示第一件事發生後，第二件事立即或幾乎立即發生，強調兩件事相隔極短時間。

rules.zh: 完整核心是 as soon as + 主語 + 動詞；主句可以放在時間子句之前或之後，但不屬於固定表達。
rules.en: The complete core is as soon as + subject + verb. The main clause may come before or after it but is not part of the fixed expression.

rules.zh: As soon as 不只表示先後次序，而是強調第二件事在第一件事之後立即或幾乎立即發生。
rules.en: As soon as does more than show sequence: it emphasises that the second event follows the first immediately or almost immediately.

rules.zh: 時間子句放在句首時，後面通常加逗號。
rules.en: When the as soon as clause comes first, it is normally followed by a comma.

rules.zh: 時間子句放在主句之後時，前面一般不需要逗號。
rules.en: When the as soon as clause follows the main clause, a comma is generally unnecessary.

rules.zh: 談論未來時，as soon as 時間子句通常使用現在式，不使用 will；主句可使用 will、can、may、should 或命令式。
rules.en: For future time, normally use the present simple in the as soon as clause, not will. The main clause may use will, can, may, should or an imperative.

rules.zh: 常見未來形式是 As soon as + 現在式, + will + 原形動詞，或 will + 原形動詞 + as soon as + 現在式。
rules.en: Common future patterns are As soon as + present simple, + will + base verb and will + base verb + as soon as + present simple.

rules.zh: 現在完成式可強調第一件工作必須完成後，第二件事才立即發生；簡單現在式和現在完成式有時都正確，但重點略有不同。
rules.en: The present perfect can emphasise that the first action must be completed before the second happens immediately. The simple present and present perfect may both be correct, with a slight difference of emphasis.

rules.zh: 描述過去事件時，時間子句和主句都可以使用過去式。
rules.en: For past events, both the time clause and the main clause may use the past simple.

rules.zh: 過去完成式可強調第一件事已完成；如果事件次序本身已很清楚，也可兩部分都用過去式。
rules.en: The past perfect may emphasise that the first event was completed. If the sequence is already clear, both clauses may use the past simple.

rules.zh: 現在式 + as soon as + 現在式可描述每次都會發生的反應或規律，而不是單一次未來事件。
rules.en: Present simple + as soon as + present simple may describe a repeated reaction or general pattern rather than a single future event.

rules.zh: 主句可以是命令句，省略的主語通常是 you。
rules.en: The main clause may be an imperative, whose understood subject is normally you.

rules.zh: 主句可以使用 can、may、should、must 或 could 等情態動詞。
rules.en: The main clause may contain a modal such as can, may, should, must or could.

rules.zh: as soon as 子句可以使用被動語態，只要後面仍是完整子句。
rules.en: The as soon as clause may be passive, provided that it remains a complete clause.

rules.zh: as soon as possible 意為「盡快」，但 possible 後沒有完整子句，因此不是本課的 as soon as + clause 目標。
rules.en: As soon as possible means as quickly as possible, but it is not the target as soon as + clause because no complete clause follows possible.

rules.zh: 不要把 as soon as 與 as long as、soon after 或 until 混淆：它們分別表達條件／持續時間、不久之後及持續至某時間點。
rules.en: Do not confuse as soon as with as long as, soon after or until: they express a condition or duration, a short delay, and continuation up to a point respectively.

benefits.zh: 這個句型清楚顯示第二件事在第一件事之後立即發生，使時間關係精確。
benefits.en: It makes the timing very clear by showing that the second action happens immediately after the first.

benefits.zh: 它把兩件緊接發生的事件直接連成一句，不必使用兩個短句和 then。
benefits.en: It combines two events in one sentence instead of using two short sentences joined only by then.

benefits.zh: 它能準確說明承諾、工作安排、顧客回覆、行程或跟進行動何時進行，適合計劃和承諾。
benefits.en: It is useful for plans and promises because it tells someone exactly when an action will be taken.

benefits.zh: 它可清楚指示某人在甚麼觸發時間採取行動，比單純說 quickly 更精確。
benefits.en: It gives clear instructions by identifying exactly when someone should carry out an action.

benefits.zh: 它顯示一件事引發立即反應，使故事的事件次序更清楚和更有動感。
benefits.en: It improves storytelling by showing that one event caused an immediate reaction.

benefits.zh: 它提供另一種自然方式表達「立即」，減少重複 immediately、at once、right away 等字眼。
benefits.en: It reduces repetition of immediately and related expressions such as at once or right away.

benefits.zh: 時間子句可放在主句之前或之後，讓你按強調重點改變句子組織方式。
benefits.en: It gives you different ways to organise a sentence by placing the time clause before or after the main action.

en: Rewrite each item using as soon as + clause to show that one event happens immediately after another.
Preserve the original meaning, tense, order of events and degree of certainty. Do not use will inside a future time clause. The as soon as clause may appear before or after the main clause.
zh: 使用 as soon as + 子句 改寫每題，表示一件事發生後另一件事立即發生。
保留原句的意思、時態、事件次序及確定程度。未來時間子句內不要使用 will。as soon as 子句可放在主句之前或之後。
